caption:
Moringa powder online, ₹199, delivered all over India: munagaku, the forgotten backyard leaf 🌿 మునగాకు
💬 Munagaku: in pappu, in podi or in tea? 👇

Every Telugu backyard once had a drumstick tree. Ammamma picked the small leaves for munagaku pappu and podi, and dried the rest in the shade for the months ahead. Today most of us only buy the drumsticks.

📊 Per 100 g fresh drumstick leaves: protein 9.4 g, calcium 185 mg (helps keep bones normal), iron 4.0 mg, vitamin C 51.7 mg (helps the body absorb iron) (Source: USDA FoodData Central)
🥄 How to use the powder: 1 tsp in dal, sambar, chapati dough or buttermilk.
